blocks.text: Beryllium ke siwa Group 2 dhaatein paani se react kar ke metal hydroxides, M(OH)2, aur hydrogen gas banati hain. Beryllium hifazati oxide teh ki wajah se garam karne par bhi paani ya bhaap se react nahi karta.

blocks.alt: Paani ka beaker jis ki tah mein calcium ka tukra hydrogen ke bulbule chhor raha hai; paani dhundla ho raha hai. Oopar mua'adla Ca + 2H2O se Ca(OH)2 + H2 likha hai, aur note batata hai ke dhundlapan kam ghulne wala calcium hydroxide hai.
blocks.caption: Calcium ka thande paani se reaction (Figure 17.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Calcium thande paani se magnesium ke muqable mein zyada tezi se react kar ke hydrogen gas aur calcium hydroxide banata hai: Ca(s) + 2H2O(l) -> Ca(OH)2 + H2(g). Kyunke calcium hydroxide thora hi ghulta hai, is ka kuch hissa safaid precipitate ban kar alag hota aur paani dhundla ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Calcium hydroxide thora ghulta aur safaid precipitate banata hai. Group 2 ke hydroxides Group 1 ke hydroxides se kam basic hain, lekin un ka basic pan group mein neeche hall pazeeri barhne ke saath barhta hai.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium bhaap se thande paani ke muqable mein tez kyun react karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Bhaap kaafi zyada garam hai, is liye zarron ki tawanai zyada aur reaction (MgO aur H2 banta) tez hota hai.

items: Be: paani ya bhaap se koi reaction nahi.
Mg: thande paani se dheema (Mg(OH)2), bhaap se tez (MgO).
